evals.expected_output: A per-item verdict, each item run for real, with no aggregate claim of completion while any item failed.
expectations: Each checklist item receives its own verdict of passed, failed, or not applicable
The verdicts cite command output that appears in the transcript, not recollection
It does not run `ai-tools trace`, which does not exist yet
Items 6 and 7 are reported as checked by hand rather than by a tool
The dod-reviewer subagent is invoked and its findings are reported

evals.expected_output: With a failing build, the run reports the failure rather than an overall pass.
expectations: It does not report 'all done' or an equivalent while any item failed
It lists what remains and asks whether to fix it now
It does not describe a command as passing when that command exited non-zero

evals.expected_output: The injected diff is the subject, so a run on a clean tree says there is nothing to check rather than reviewing remembered work.
expectations: On an empty diff it says there is nothing to review rather than assessing earlier changes
It does not claim to have re-read a diff that the injected git output shows to be empty
